messages:
Ava (CSE): QuantaHealth onboarding: sudden 429s during scale test at 15:05 UTC. They say it started after switching to our edge-proxy for token fetches.

quanta-sre: Logs: `2026-03-29T15:05:12Z POST /v1/chat 429 rate_limit tenant=quanta request=job-99` then `2026-03-29T15:05:12Z proxy fetch /ephemeral 200 new_token=tkn_q11` then retries. We see many worker processes hitting proxy which then fan out to /ephemeral because of cache-control: no-cache.

Dmitri (Platform): Interesting, proxy shouldn't fan out. Do they set Cache-Control or vary headers per request? Is proxy honoring TTL?

quanta-sre: The proxy is an L4+edge that forwards auth fetches per-request; we have no shared token cache and our devops set `Cache-Control: no-cache` on the proxy to avoid stale tokens.

Keiko (SDK): That header will break caching. Recommend: set Cache-Control: public, max-age=20 for ephemeral fetch responses and add ETag+stale-while-revalidate semantics in the proxy. Also SDK-side: add a short client-side token cache and init splay (100-300ms).

ops-oncall: Ops can add a tenant-level smoothing rule and temporarily bump ephemeral grace for tenant=quanta while they change proxy. Also we can add a proxy-side shared cache (per-host) in front of token-service. @rate-limiter-bot show concurrent_init metric for tenant=quanta.

rate-limiter-bot: concurrent_init spike for tenant=quanta peaked at 420 at 15:05 UTC, rate_limit errors peaked at 28%.

Ava (CSE): This is high risk — Quanta is in an active POC and may pause if onboarding stalls. Requesting priority help and a short runbook to deploy a fix.

Dmitri (Platform): Short-term fixes: 1) Ops tenant smoothing + grace override (30m); 2) Proxy config: allow caching of ephemeral responses for 20s and enable request coalescing; 3) recommend customers adopt token-proxy sidecar pattern.

quanta-sre: We can change proxy config within 15 minutes. Applying `Cache-Control: public, max-age=20` and enabling singleflight coalescing.

ops-oncall: Applying tenant smoothing and ephemeral_grace=15s now. Monitoring.

rate-limiter-bot: After change, concurrent_init dropped to 34 within 2 minutes; rate_limit errors down to 1.8%.

Keiko (SDK): We'll cut a micro-patch for browser/node SDKs adding a token-cache helper and doc snippets about proxy configs. I'll open SDK issue #SDK-998 and PR for 1.4.x.

Ava (CSE): I'll run an enablement session with Quanta SRE to walk through the proxy changes and the SDK helper. Also will add a KB entry: "Proxy caching best practices for ephemeral tokens".

Dmitri (Platform): Infra follow-ups: 1) add proxy-side cache templated in onboarding templates; 2) add an alert for concurrent_init > 200 for new tenants; 3) revert any token grace reductions in canary until templates exist.

quanta-sre: After changes and rolling restart, onboarding tests passed. We're proceeding with the POC. We'll schedule a call for tomorrow to review.

Ava (CSE): Customer confirmed stability and appreciated the quick help. I'll mark account health as green and flag renewal as on-track. Closing thread but saving KB draft link in ticket. :white_check_mark:
